messages:
Noah Li: FYI I ran into duplicated generation calls in the new Next App Router + LlamaIndex starter when deployed to an edge runtime.
Priya Shah: Oof. Which SDK version and starter?
Noah Li: starter: next-approuter-llamaindex v0.3, SDK: @redwood/inference-js@0.9.1. Repro: open /ssr-query, single user query -> two outgoing requests recorded.
Omar Reyes: Any transport logs? 429s or a network error?
Noah Li: Logs show fetch-level retry followed by sdk retry: 
[2026-03-15T12:00:01Z] transport: fetch error (retrying)
[2026-03-15T12:00:01Z] sdk: retry attempt=2
Noah Li: Adding explicit Idempotency-Key fixed it locally (only one request).
Priya Shah: Short term: update starter server handler to set header or pass { autoIdempotency: true } for server runtimes. Also call out in README.
Omar Reyes: Long-term: JS SDK should mirror Python and auto-add idempotency header when running in server/edge contexts unless disabled. Will track as an SDK ticket.
devex-bot: Created ticket #2099: "next-approuter starter: prevent double inference on Edge SSR" and assigned to @Omar Reyes
